title: Size.
officialText:
The touchdown or landing area for helicopters of less than 3,500 pounds (1588 kg) shall be a minimum of 20 feet (6096
mm) in length and width. The touchdown area shall be surrounded on all sides by a clear area having a minimum average width at roof
level of 15 feet (4572 mm) but with no width less than 5 feet (1524 mm).
